title: Woman with black undulating eyes at foot of bed

tellings.quote: So, I lower the paper and there's a woman standing at the foot of my bed. Her eyes are two black circles that are undulating.
so I lower the paper and there's a woman standing at the foot of my bed.
tellings.difference: Here her eyes are like the cosmos (the story's telling has two black undulating circles); it adds that she pinned him to the bed, places it in a bungalow off Melrose early in his writing career, and calls her the witch rider.
tellings.link_reason: The same encounter: Brent lowers his paper and sees a woman standing at the foot of his bed, with strange eyes.

as_told.title: Translucent woman with cosmos eyes pins Brent to the bed (the witch rider)
as_told.place_text: bungalow apartment off Melrose, Los Angeles

plain: A screenwriter named Brent Friedman says he lowered the paper he was reading in bed and saw a woman standing at the foot of the bed, her eyes two black, undulating circles. He tells Michels this happened to him. In another telling of the same night he describes her eyes as like the cosmos, says she pinned him to the bed, places it in a bungalow off Melrose early in his writing career, and calls her the witch rider.
